# MemoryFn

> Scoped memory storage, semantic retrieval, revisioned updates, and deletion for applications and agents.

## Documentation

- [Embeddings and extraction](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/embeddings-and-extraction.md) — Configure supported providers and understand ingestion and deduplication behavior.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Add, update, and forget scoped memories with the TypeScript package.
- [HTTP adapter](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/http.md) — Mount the authorized MemoryFn router and understand its request boundary.
- [MemoryFn documentation](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Scoped memory storage, retrieval, updates, and forgetting for application developers.
- [MCP adapter](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/mcp.md) — Expose scoped MemoryFn tools through a trusted stdio host.
- [Operations and current limits](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/operations-and-limits.md) — Supported configuration, migration responsibility, tests, and proof boundaries.
- [Public API](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/reference/api.md) — MemoryFn package entry points, methods, input types, and adapters.
- [API reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — Public TypeScript entry points and source-aligned package guidance.
- [Package overview](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/reference/package-overview.md) — Source-aligned MemoryFn guidance from origin/dev.
- [Storage and lifecycle source guide](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/reference/storage-lifecycle.md) — Source-aligned MemoryFn guidance from origin/dev.
- [Scope and lifecycle](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/scope-and-lifecycle.md) — Tenant and tag constraints, optimistic revisions, updates, and tombstones.
- [Semantic search](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/search.md) — Query scoped vector memories and enforce host authorization on results.
- [Storage and migrations](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/memoryfn/docs/content/docs/storage.md) — PostgreSQL setup, connection ownership, transaction requirements, and custom adapters.
